command_executed: ./websearch --no-cache -m reason "Why does my Go program deadlock when using sync.WaitGroup inside a goroutine that also writes to an unbuffered channel with no concurrent reader"

evaluation.summary: 4.5/5.0 - Precise deadlock chain-of-thought diagnosis with three fix strategies, but no runnable code examples
evaluation.key_strengths: Correctly identifies the exact three-step circular dependency (sender blocks on unbuffered channel, wg.Done() never executes, wg.Wait() blocks forever) and offers three distinct fix options covering all common resolutions.
evaluation.key_weaknesses: All three fix options are described in prose only with no concrete Go code snippets, which reduces the ability for a developer to immediately copy and apply a working solution.
